description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts (support+NEI); one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Occipital activation levels are associated with auditory spatial performance in parietal regions of the brain.
Claim 2: Auditory entrainment is strengthened when people see congruent visual and auditory information.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Occipital activation levels are associated with auditory spatial performance in parietal regions of the brain.
Auditory entrainment is strengthened when people see congruent visual and auditory information.
rationale: UNLABELLED Congruent audiovisual speech enhances our ability to comprehend a speaker, even in noise-free conditions.

When incongruent auditory and visual information is presented concurrently, it can hinder a listener's perception and even cause him or her to perceive information that was not presented in either modality.
We demonstrate that the cortical representation of the speech envelope is enhanced by the presentation of congruent audiovisual speech in noise-free conditions.
Finally, our data suggest that neural entrainment to the speech envelope is inhibited when the auditory and visual streams are incongruent both temporally and contextually.
SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT Seeing a speaker's face as he or she talks can greatly help in understanding what the speaker is saying.
Specifically, we show that the brain's representation of auditory speech is enhanced when the accompanying visual speech signal shares the same timing.
